£ SEE" PAYMENT IN LIEU OF TAX (“PILOT”) AGREEMENT THIS AGREEMENT is hereby entered into by and between Urban Housing Solutions (“the Property a Tennessee not-for-profit general welfare corporation, and the Meiropolitan Government of and Davidson County (“Metro”), with reference to a parcel of property located at 1446 Ardee Avenue, Nashville, Tennessee 37216, being a portion of Map and Parcel Number 072-04-0 215.00 on the Tax Map of Davidson County and comprising approximately 2.18 acres (the “Subject Property”). WHEREAS, Tennessee Code Annotated § 67-5-207 provides an exemption from local ad valorem taxes for any portion of real property, owned by a qualifying Tennessee not-for-profit corporation, that is used for permanent housing of low income ‘persons with disabilities, or low income elderly or handicapped persons and financed by grants or loans as provided in T.C.A. § 67-5-207(a)(1); and, WHEREAS, pursuant to the provisions of Tennessee Code Annotated § 67-5- 207(a)(2), all or part of the Subject Property including more than twelve (12) units may be approved for an exemption from ad valorem taxes; and, WHEREAS, said legislation requires a payment in licu of taxes on the approved portion, based upon the estimated cost of improvements, facilities or services rendered by the applicable governmental agency; and, WHEREAS, the Property Owner has filed an application to the State Board of Equalization (the “Board”) for an exemption from said taxation, and the Board currently has said application under review to determine whether the Subject Property, or a part thereof, qualifies for exemption in accordance with the provisions of T.C.A. § 67-5-207. 2nd Settings Desktop PILOT AgreementForm doc Page 1 of 8 ARCHIVE
AND WHEREAS, by Ordinance No. BL2004 -228, the Metropolitan Council has authorized the Metropolitan Government to enter into the necessary agreements with the owners of qualifying properties to collect payments in lieu of ad valorem taxes. NOW, THEREFORE, for good and valuable consideration, the receipt and adequacy of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree as follows: Section
1. Date. The effective date shall be the effective date of the exemption as determined by the Board, by and through its designee, unless the determination of the Board is appealed. Should the Board’s determination, as made by its designee, be appealed, the effective date shall be the effective date, if any, as established at the conclusion of the matter. Section
2. Obligation of the Property Owner. It is hereby agreed between the parties that the Property Owner shall pay to Metro a sum equivalent to 25% of the ad valorem and personalty property taxes that would otherwise be due for the portion of Subject Property that has received exemption from the Board pursuant to T.C.A. § 67-5- 207. Section
3. Initial Payment. The initial payment shall cover a period retroactive to the date of approval of the exemption by the Board, as determined in accordance with the provisions of T.C.A. § 67-5-212(b). Section
4. Annual Report. Property Owner hereby agrees to file a report annually with the Assessor of Property identifying any changes to the Subject Property, its ownership, occupancy or financing that might affect its exempt status, on a form to be provided by the Assessor’s Office. Said form shall be provided by the Assessor’s Office to the Property agent, as identified under Section 11, below, unless otherwise nd Settings doc Page 2 of 8 ARCHIVE
requested in writing by an authorized party, by January 15, each tax year, and Property Owner shall complete said form, and return same to the Assessor’s Office by March 1, the same year. Failure to timely complete and return said form is ground for the Assessor's Office to retum the Subject Property in its entirety to the tax roll upon written notice to the Property Owner. Property Owner may appeal a decision taken pursuant to this Section in accordance with the provisions of T.C.A. § 67-5-207(c) and T.C.A. § 67- Section
5. Reappriasal Cycle Review. At teast once per reappraisal cycle, the Assessor’s Office shall request and Property Owner shall promptly provide data necessary to value the Subject Property. Section
6. Annual Adjustment. The Assessor of Property shall have the authority to make annual adjustments to the Board’s initial determination. Such adjustments may be appealed pursuant to the provisions of T.C.A. § 67-5-207(c) and T.C.A. § 67-5-212(b){4). Section
7. Annual Payment. Payments pursuant to this Agreement will be due and payable to the Office of the Trustee at the same time and in the same manner as ad valorem taxes. Section
8. Term. Said payments shall continue annuaily through the term of any loan or grant as described in T.C.A. § 67-5-207 (a) or for so long as the Subject Property is exempt under the terms and to the extent provided in T.C.A. § 67-5-207. Section
9. Scope. The portion of Subject Property that does not qualify for exemption will be subject to ad valorem taxes. and Settings Desktop PILOTA greementForm doc Page 3 of 8 ARCHIVE

blocks.text: 10. Remedies for Default. Should the Property Owner fail to timely pay to the in lieu of tax payment, Metro shall have all remedies available to Metro for the collection of real property taxes. The Property Owner agrees that ail unpaid in lieu of tax payments shall bear interest in the same amount as unpaid real property taxes pursuant to T.C.A. § 67-1-101, et seq. If at any time the Property Owner fails to continue to timely make the in of tax payment to Metro, operate the Subject Property for the exempt uses, or otherwise fails to meet the requirements of T.C.A. § 67-5-207, Metro has a right to terminate this Agreement. Upon termination of this Agreement, the Subject Property shali be assessed for taxes as though the property were non-exempt under T.C.A. § Section 11. Notices. Notices required herein may be given by registered or certified or express mail by depositing the same in the United States Mail or by private courier in the continental United States, postage prepaid. Either party shall have the right, by giving written notice to the other, to change the address at which its notices are to be received. (e) Acknowledgement. The parties hereto, or their authorized acknowledge that they have read this Agreement, including any annexes or attachments hereto, and have sought and received whatever competent advice and counsel necessary for them to form a full and complete understanding of all rights and obligations herein. Applicable Law. The parties agree that this Agreement is executed in and is to be performed in the State of Tennessee, and that all provisions of this Agreement and any dispute arising hereunder shall be governed by the laws of the State of Tennessee. Any dispute arising out of this Agreement shall be litigated in the courts of Davidson County, Tennessee. (g) Other Costs. It is agreed and understood that said payment in lieu of taxes is entirely separate from, and in addition to, any other obligations that may be required as a matter of local, state or federal law, including any attomey fees that may arise in connection with this agreement. {h) No Agency. Anything herein to the contrary notwithstanding, Property Owner is not the agent of Metro. The parties hereto are neither partners nor joint venturers and neither shall the parties hold themselves out to be partners or joint venturers. The parties shall hold the status of Metro and Property Owner only. Settings greementForm Page 6 of 8 ARCHIVE
(i) No Assignment without Consent. The provisions of this Agreement shall inure to the benefit of and shall be binding on the respective successors and assigns of the parties hereto. Neither this Agreement nor any of the rights and obligations of Property Owner hereunder shall be assigned or transferred in whole or in part to any person, firm or corporation without the prior written consent of Metro. Any such assignment or transfer shall not release Property Owner from its obligations hereunder. Any approved assignee shall assume each and every obligation of Property Owner hercunder, and Metro may contract with or accept moncys from any such assignee without waiving any of its Tights.
